questions: Were you able to hear or understand what was happening around you while on the ground?
Did you feel lightheaded, dizzy, or like the room was spinning before you fell?
Did you experience chest pain, palpitations, or shortness of breath immediately before falling?
Did you have any jerking movements of your arms or legs while on the ground?
Did you bite your tongue or lose control of your bladder during the episode?
Did you feel confused, sleepy, or disoriented for more than a few minutes after standing up?
Do you have a history of diabetes?
Have you recently started or changed any medications?
